title: Index current automatic mailbox install-intent lookups during catalog discovery
outcome: Avoid the per-candidate linear scan of retained binding install intents under StateInner during automatic remote catalog discovery, while preserving exact binding/native creation/current-authority checks.
acceptance: Current participant discovery uses an indexed intent lookup with exact binding and native creation validation; document any remaining placement scan cost rather than claiming constant time.
Focused multi-root and retained-intent coverage preserves refusal and directory behavior, and review confirms no authority widening.
